definitions.false_identity_rate_known: decisions that name a SKU that is not the true one, over all decisions on objects whose product is registered (abstain and unknown count in the denominator, never in the numerator)
definitions.unknown_named_as_sku: decisions that name any registered SKU, over all decisions on objects whose product is not registered (held-out products); abstain and unknown are the wanted outcomes
definitions.latency_p95_ms: 95th percentile wall-clock of IdentityEngine.identify (embedding, OCR, barcode; crop already cut) per decision on this box, CPU; no duty budget is written anywhere in the repository, so 2 s per decision is declared here as the budget

reported_without_bound: rate at which unknown products are explicitly called unknown
look-alike twin confusion (a wrong SKU that is the true SKU's look-alike partner)
all of the above per range band and per lighting condition, with Wilson intervals

protocol.calibration_data: train and validation seeds only; registry products train + validation; unknown-product samples come from leaving registered products out of the index in turn (3 folds over the 9 calibration products); thresholds fitted at half of each bound (calibration ceilings 0.005 and 0.025)
protocol.held_out_run: exactly once, after the calibration file is written and committed; the registry is train + validation products, held-out products are unknown; whatever comes out is reported, pass or fail, and thresholds are not re-tuned afterwards
protocol.pass_rule: the point estimate of each bounded rate is at or below its bound; the Wilson interval is reported next to it and a pass whose interval crosses the bound is labelled inconclusive rather than demonstrated
protocol.training: none; AGENT_BRIEF section 3.3 holds; whitening is fit on unlabeled calibration crops only
